name: Chijoku no Gyaku Kyouikujisshuu ~Josou Pet ni Otosareru Boku~
original_name: 恥辱の逆教育実習 ～女装ペットに堕とされる僕～
source:
* Otoko no ko (crossdressing boy) hentai game! 
Forced to wear girls clothes, he can't run away from the shame anymore... 

Caught by girls, total stripped naked, wearing girls clothes, made to ejaculate, abused verbally, scornful teasing... How much humiliation can one boy take!? Why is such misery turned to pleasure!? 

Coerced girlie boy cosplay shy slavery - a visual novel game!
